get.description:
Live updates: `event` = card.created, alert.created, ..., `data` = {"id"}. `resync`
means events may have been missed: refetch. Keep-alive pings every 15 s (FastAPI).

PRD §16 metrics over `window`: `session` (since process start), `day` (24 h, default)
or `7d`. In-process counters (`*_since_start`) ignore the window.

post.description: Idempotent on the endpoint: re-subscribing refreshes the keys and un-revokes it.
